summary.text: Charles Burkett, a former mayor of Surfside, is running for governor as an independent, with running mate Ruben A. Coto.

paragraphs.text: Burkett served as mayor of Surfside from 2006 to 2010, from 2020 to 2022 and from 2024 to 2026.
WLRN describes him as a former four-term mayor and reported that, as mayor in 2021, he navigated the community through the Champlain Towers South condominium collapse.

sources.title: Former Surfside mayor Charles Burkett in Florida governor's race
